purpose: Define the evidence and assessment prerequisites for future per-dimension alternative comparison without comparing raw LiuYao evidence or creating a hidden global score.

observationPlan.role: resolve selected traditional observation candidates to concrete line targets

timeAssessment.role: normalize TimeEffect dimensions into support, peer, constraint, outflow, exertion and trigger structure
timeAssessment.notes: The validator explicitly rejects legacy evaluative tokens such as supportive, adverse, preferred and caution.

interpretation.role: learner-facing explanatory judgment construction and support/constraint narrative grouping
interpretation.notes: Interpretation helper classifications must not be promoted into cross-alternative ordering without a separately reviewed Assessment contract.

principles: Comparator input must be reviewed Assessment output, never raw status tags, raw TimeEffects, raw ObservationPlan targets, evidence counts or user-facing prose.
A dimension label alone does not make two assessments comparable.
Every ordering comparator is owned by a domain Assessment contract family and versioned independently.
No global ordering supportive > mixed > adverse is registered in v0.1.
No active comparator means comparisonStatus=incomparable, not a fallback heuristic ranking.

External factual dimensions such as legal exposure, exact cost, salary amount or travel time must use their factual/domain providers rather than divination evidence unless an independently reviewed divination Assessment exists.

notes: contractFamily must be explicit; it must not be inferred from contractRef naming conventions.
semanticMeaning must be explicit; equal dimensionId alone is insufficient for comparability.

candidateDimensionReadiness.reason: Employment retention, employment transition, admission, litigation outcome and other targets do not yet share one reviewed outcome Assessment contract family. Same label is not enough for ordering.
Current-employment retention has a clearer evidence path than prospective-employment stability. A symmetric stability Assessment contract does not yet exist.
Salary, cash runway and income continuity require factual/current income providers; no LiuYao-wide livelihood ordering contract exists.
Institution anchoring may be partial and no reviewed institution-fit Assessment contract exists.
Traditional settlement/dissipation evidence is researched, but no formal versioned dispute-resolution Assessment output exists to compare.
This is a high-stakes legal factual/risk dimension and must not be inferred or ordered from divination evidence in this design.
Exact money cost/value is heterogeneous factual data and not a LiuYao comparator dimension without a separate provider contract.
Existing Time Assessment describes temporal effects and must not be repurposed into a generic duration-cost ordering.
Risk has different semantics across employment, education and litigation; there is no global risk comparator.

steps: Validate both dimension assessments are structurally present.
Require same dimensionId and explicitly compatible semantic meaning.
Require same reviewed assessmentContractFamily and compatible contract versions.
Look up an active registered comparatorRef owned by that contract family.
If no comparator exists, return incomparable/comparator_not_registered.
Never infer order from assessmentStatus labels alone.

futureActivationGate: positive/mixed/adverse or equivalent states defined within that domain without hidden scoring
ordering semantics reviewed for the exact dimension
comparator regression includes mixed, partial and abstention cases
no high-stakes modern factual dimension is replaced by divination inference
current-22 behavior remains frozen unless separately migrated
